items.title: HOST-TEST RUNNER — author the host-orchestrated runner
items.description: Authoring ACT must ship: (a) the runner binary / script, (b) the corpus/result schema, (c) at least one minimal invocation per dependent ACT (real-kernel Seatbelt probe + fresh VSIX dogfood + live approval-UI capture), (d) the audit-log contract (ACT ID, source HEAD, corpus file path, runner version, host OS / kernel, start/end wall time, full result; appended to `.factory/evidence/<ACT>/`). No widening of authority: the runner runs as the host user, does not gain Seatbelt privileges the user lacks, and is not a covert YOLO bypass. A separate ACT is also required (NOT part of the runner ACT) to reclassify prior per-test Vitest `skipIf(!HAS_SUBSTRATE)` callers from `SKIP` to `HOST_REQUIRED` via the runner.
